scope: F2 fold-0 screen. New feature block: Regularization of sparse passenger contexts - penalizes overfitting on rare categorical combinations.

H58_RARE_COMBINATION.question: Does regularizing sparse categorical combinations (via target encoding with adaptive shrinkage) improve fold-0 OOF AUC?
H58_RARE_COMBINATION.method: For each categorical combination, compute target encoding with adaptive shrinkage based on count (James-Stein shrinkage). Cross-fit: compute on folds 1-4, apply to fold-0. Add to 21raw. LGBM fold-0.
H58_RARE_COMBINATION.leakage: Shrinkage statistics computed on FIT only (folds 1-4). Applied to fold-0. Fold-safe.
H58_RARE_COMBINATION.decision_rule: PROMISING if fold-0 port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995.
